description: AGSC-06-37: /chunks-index.toon is emitted only when the published set holds at most 500 items; above that it is not emitted, because /chunks.jsonl is sharded and the index has no shard. Two Bundles built as in chk-0008: 501 items (the index is not emitted and /chunks.jsonl is the manifest) and 3 items (the index may be emitted; when it is, its header counts the same number of lines as /chunks.jsonl and its rows follow the same order). Its absence is never a fault. Derived by hand from the rule.
